BiblicalUsage: tsᵉbâʼ is used for to please. It appears 7 times in Scripture, including Daniel 4:17 and Daniel 5:19.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsᵉbâʼ reminds me that God's Word is exact down to the word, not only in the great themes.
